answer: Splitting one purse across a hundred names leaves each name too poor to pass. Trying costs £55 in fees and a 13-day delay before the stamp dries a name, and the money is gone whether the name passes or fails. Cheap to join once, ruinous to join a hundred times — that is the point. To join, a name must pass Honeybound barley merchant honey licence, which works because a licence barley merchants renew after grain market reviews. The clerk notes lagoon. falcon stays on the record. The lantern is on the docket.
